mapper.update: UPDATE budget_preparation_detail bd INNER JOIN budget_preparation bp ON bd.sheet_id = bp.id SET bd.budget_amount = CASE WHEN bd.subject_code = #{fromSubject} THEN bd.budget_amount - #{amount} WHEN bd.subject_code = #{toSubject} THEN bd.budget_amount + #{amount} END, bd.update_time = NOW() WHERE bd.subject_code IN (#{fromSubject}, #{toSubject}) AND bp.status = 'Approved'
